profile.name: Lumiloop LS 三轴电场探头
profile.name_en: Lumiloop LS Three-Axis Electric Field Probe
profile.description: 这是一种三轴电场场强探头，用于测量空间中电场的三个正交分量及合成场强。它适合实验室中的电磁场测试、场强校准和环境电场监测等用途。
profile.description_en: This is a three-axis electric-field probe used to measure the three orthogonal components of an electric field and the resulting field magnitude. It is suitable for laboratory electromagnetic-field testing, field-strength calibration, and ambient electric-field monitoring.

registry.description: Lumiloop LS Probe是Lumiloop GmbH提供的设备驱动，提供magnitude, magnitude_all, frequency, frequency等6个控制接口。
